definition: TeLQAS (Telecommunication Literature Question Answering System) is an experimental question answering system developed for answering English questions in the telecommunications domain..
details: TeLQAS (Telecommunication Literature Question Answering System) is an experimental question answering system developed for answering English questions in the telecommunications domain.
story: Picture a scoreboard at a science fair: you need a fair, agreed way to tell who actually won. A fair scoreboard keeps everyone honest. Before trusting a machine, someone has to measure how good it really is — fairly and honestly. A good metric is a ruler that does not bend when you lean on it. And that, done honestly, is TeLQAS.
